Eastern Association of Rowing Colleges | The Eastern Association of Rowing Colleges (EARC) is a college athletic conference of eighteen men's college rowing crews.  It is an affiliate of the Eastern College Athletic Conference (ECAC).

List of Utah Utes football seasons | The Utah Utes football program is a college football team that represents the University of Utah. In 1938 the Utah, along with six other RMAC schools left the conference to form the Mountain States Conference, more commonly known as the Big Seven. But in beam search, only a predetermined number of best partial solutions are kept as candidates.  It is thus a greedy algorithm.
